topics.question: How has your community changed, and what evidence shows it?
topics.example: Our community has added new bus routes and public spaces. These changes make some journeys easier, although busy roads remain a problem. Comparing travel times could help us understand the improvement more clearly.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What makes a person inspiring?
topics.example: I admire people who keep working toward a useful goal despite difficulties. Their actions show courage and care for others. When describing them, I prefer specific examples to general praise.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How do you decide whether a learning strategy works?
topics.example: I set a clear goal and practise regularly. Then I check whether I can use what I have learned in a new situation. Feedback helps me adjust my method instead of repeating it without thought.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Which memory matters to you, and why?
topics.example: I remember working with classmates on a difficult project. We disagreed at first, but learned to listen and divide the tasks. The experience reminds me that cooperation often needs patience.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How can an idea become a useful invention?
topics.example: A useful invention begins with a real problem. The designer develops an idea, tests a simple version and listens to users. Improving the design may take several attempts rather than one sudden success.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: Why do people explore space?
topics.example: Space exploration can help us understand the universe and develop technology. It also raises questions about cost and priorities. I think we should compare the benefits and challenges using reliable evidence.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: How can music connect people?
topics.example: Music allows people to share feelings and cultural stories. Even when listeners do not understand every word, they may respond to the rhythm. Learning about the background can deepen that connection.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文

topics.question: What can sport teach beyond winning?
topics.example: Sport can teach teamwork, responsibility and respect for rules. A team may lose a game but still improve through honest reflection. I value players who support others and compete fairly.
topics.kind: 原创主题训练_非教材原文
